Off Calendar Sep-27-2012 Text Ruling

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-27-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ksenia Tsenin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sarah Lerschen #6213.
Petitioner Nina Guo was present in pro per as guardian ad litem for the Minor Melina Nina Carranza-Guo, Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Copy of the proof of service on notice to the minor's father Francisco Javier Carranza was presented in open court.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Melina Nina Guo.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
